description: This file defines callback functions for J1939 TP module, including indications of received PDUs and transmission confirmations. It serves as an interface for communication between lower layer modules and the J1939 transport protocol.

methods.name: J1939Tp_RxIndication
methods.description: Indicates that a PDU has been received from a lower layer.

methods.name: J1939Tp_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms that a PDU has been transmitted.
